description: Users with at least one active push-notification token. SUM(user_count) WHERE is_reachable=1.
Users who opened the app at least once in the month (New + Returning + Resurrected). SUM(user_count) WHERE app_open_flag=1.
Users opening the app for the first time. SUM(user_count) WHERE app_open_lifecycle_bucket='New'.
Users who opened the app last month and this month. SUM(user_count) WHERE app_open_lifecycle_bucket='Returning'.
Users who re-opened the app after a dormancy gap. SUM(user_count) WHERE app_open_lifecycle_bucket='Resurrected'.
Users dormant for less than 6 months. SUM(user_count) WHERE app_open_lifecycle_bucket='Dormant <6mo'.
Users dormant for 6+ months (effectively churned). SUM(user_count) WHERE app_open_lifecycle_bucket='Dormant 6mo+'.
Users who have ever held a D2C car policy. SUM(user_count) WHERE car_ever_customer=1.
Users with an active D2C car policy this month. SUM(user_count) WHERE car_active=1.
Users who have ever held a D2C bike policy. SUM(user_count) WHERE bike_ever_customer=1.
Users with an active D2C bike policy this month. SUM(user_count) WHERE bike_active=1.
Combined Car+Bike ever-customer. SUM(user_count) WHERE car_ever_customer=1 OR bike_ever_customer=1. Never sum car+bike separately — user may hold both.
Users who have ever held a D2C health policy. SUM(user_count) WHERE health_ever_customer=1.
Users who have ever held a D2C life policy. SUM(user_count) WHERE life_ever_customer=1.
Users who have ever held a D2C travel policy. SUM(user_count) WHERE travel_ever_customer=1.
Out of health_ever_customer base, users who also have life_ever_customer=1.
Users who engaged with auto VAS (challan/fastag/PUCC/RTO/valuation/service). SUM(user_count) WHERE auto_vas_engaged_flag=1.
Users who hit any D2C entry/quote/payment funnel event. SUM(user_count) WHERE product_entry_flag=1.
Car owner with zero policies across all LOBs. car_owner=1 AND all ever_customer flags=0.
Bike owner with zero policies across all LOBs. bike_owner=1 AND all ever_customer flags=0.
